name: Yuke Zhu

affiliations.role: Associate professor, Robot Perception and Learning Lab

bio: Yuke Zhu is an associate professor of computer science at UT Austin, where Zhu directs the Robot Perception and Learning Lab, and a director and distinguished research scientist at NVIDIA Research who co-leads the GEAR lab. Zhu was a project lead on GR00T N1 and is known for open-source robot learning platforms.
known_for: Director of UT Austin Robot Perception and Learning Lab
GR00T N1 and open robot learning software
